$comment: Frozen input JSON Schema for routine_template_compile, v1. Envelope law only: template/slots/save keys, slots is an object, every slot leaf is string-or-null except bands (array of strings). Template validity, slot-name validity, and value grammar are COMPILER-stage refusals with named findings, not schema rejections (design SS1: enumerate-and-teach beats reject-at-the-gate for those classes). Schema violations are HARD tool errors naming the offending key or path.

template.description: One of the template ids listed in the tool description.

slots.description: The template's slots. Every value is a string or null, except bands: an array of band-label strings.

save.description: false/omitted: compile and validate a draft only. true: also save (create-only; never enables or runs).
